demoConv.text: Demo: E.V.’s replies here are scripted, and the check-in advice is a fixed line for each energy level. The real ones come from her runs.

demoPlan.text: Demo: this proposal is a fixed example. The real Plan the rest reruns the morning planner on today’s list as it stands; what it would add is proposed as an addition, and what it defers is proposed as a take-off. Nothing changes until he accepts.

demoBudget.text: Demo: the 90-minute budget is fixed here. The real one is the day budget from her plan.

demoNotes.text: Demo, scripted: typing in a note isn’t wired. New note plays the ABG lecture in, block by block, and the format bar applies to the caret’s line. E.V.’s lines are fixed: the step-3 check and its two answers, the proposed weak spot, the link to the potassium note, and one canned answer per view in the bar. Anything typed to her gets a scripted reply. The session clock runs in real time. Desktop only.
